thinking.description: 1-3 sentences reasoning about the snippet before deciding what to save. Never skip this.

subject_name.description: The main entity the snippet is about. Confirm or correct the hinted subject; do not invent an unrelated one.

no_new_information.description: True only when everything in the snippet is already known/redundant and nothing should be saved. If true, new_facts is ignored even if non-empty.

new_facts.description: Facts you do NOT already know and are declaring must be saved. Empty when no_new_information is true.

relation.description: Snake_case-ish verb naming the relation, e.g. 'located_in', 'born_in', 'has_occupation'.

confidence.description: Omit for a flat, certain assertion. Use a hedge word only when the snippet itself hedges ('may be', 'is thought to').

known_facts.description: Short phrases naming things in the snippet you recognize as already known/redundant. Transparency only; never written to the database.
